description: Follow ice hockey with API-Hockey: games and results with the score by period, goals and penalties, standings, team season statistics, head-to-head records and bookmakers' pre-match odds, for more than 250 leagues and cups, from the NHL and the AHL to the KHL, Sweden's SHL, Finland's Liiga and the world championships. Needs an API-SPORTS key; the free plan allows 100 requests a day.
